tool_args.rationale: The pilot signatures and monotone-concave response support the shared two-layer siphon base. The acquired open-branch probe supplies the needed s_grad leverage and is consistent with the positive square-root branch. Fit vmax, rho, and the local branch coefficient numerically over the supplied wide parameter bounds.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The available discriminating row is at s_grad=2.35, below the specified 2.36 threshold for the high-gradient probe; the observed outputs do not show a high-gradient avalanche signature.
The seven rows span broad s_grad values and multiple u_now values, sufficient to fit the three-parameter base siphon plus open square-root branch; the higher-cost batch is unnecessary.
It predicts a drop at high u_now, whereas the pilot outputs increase monotonically with u_now.
